description: Make a bold entrance in this eye-catching Flame Red Clearcoat 2024 Ram 3500 Laramie Longhorn. This heavy-duty truck isn't just about muscle, its a high-end sanctuary on wheels. Whether you use Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, or Alexa Built-In, staying connected is seamless. You also get modern conveniences like a wireless charging pad and a 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot to keep your devices ready for the road ahead.Safety and ConvenienceSafety is a top priority in this Ram 3500. Features like Blind Spot & Cross Path Detection, Auto High-beam Headlights, and rain-sensing wipers work behind the scenes to keep you secure. Parking a truck this size is made simple with the ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera and power-folding mirrors with turn signal indicators. Its a complete package that offers the perfect blend of legendary durability and modern sophistication.Faster. Simpler. More Transparent. The 'Touring' TreatmentThe Touring trim was actually new for 2017, designed to compete with entry-level luxury SUVs. Capability & SafetySubaru didn't sacrifice utility for the fancy leather. Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. description: The 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Limited AWD 4-door crossover blends rugged capability with refined comfort, making it a versatile choice for drivers who want adventure without sacrificing everyday practicality. Built on Subaru’s signature all-wheel-drive platform, this Outback is designed for confident handling in a wide range of conditions, from snowy backroads to busy urban streets. Its exterior styling is purposeful and rugged, with slightly flared wheel arches, roof rails with integrated crossbars, and a higher ground clearance than typical wagons or SUVs so you can tackle light trails and uneven terrain without worry. Under the hood, the 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine delivers smooth, linear power that’s well suited for daily commuting, highway cruising, and hauling gear. While it’s not a high-performance engine, the power output is balanced and efficient, providing respectable acceleration and good fuel economy for a vehicle of this size and capability. The engine is paired with a continuously variable automatic transmission (CVT) that keeps rpm steady and helps maximize efficiency, especially during long drives. One of this model’s standout attributes is its standard Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive system, which continuously delivers power to all four wheels for enhanced traction and stability — particularly reassuring in rain, snow, or gravel. Step inside the Limited trim and you’ll find a comfortable and well-appointed cabin with premium touches that elevate the driving experience. Soft leather upholstery, heated front seats, and dual-zone automatic climate control are standard, adding a layer of luxury unusual in this segment. The driver’s seat typically offers multiple power adjustments, ensuring a relaxed driving position for long trips. Rear seat passengers benefit from generous legroom and headroom, making this Outback a great option for families or car-poolers. Cargo space is another highlight: the Outback’s wagon-like design offers a roomy rear cargo area that easily swallows luggage, outdoor gear, or groceries, and the rear seats fold flat to expand space further. On the road, the Outback delivers a composed and comfortable ride. Its suspension soaks up bumps with ease, and the steering is predictable and confidence-inspiring. Safety features are plentiful in the Limited trim, often including adaptive cruise control, lane-keep assist, blind-spot monitoring, and a rear-view camera, contributing to peace of mind for drivers and passengers alike. In summary, the 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Limited AWD is a well-rounded, capable crossover that balances comfort, utility, and everyday usability with the added assurance of all-weather performance.

Safety and Security
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.

The premium audio system with navigation keeps you connected and entertained, while the intuitive controls and large touchscreen display make it easy to access all the features you need.

Safety is also a top priority, with a comprehensive suite of advanced driver-assistance technologies, including the Emergency Communication System, Rear Camera, and Blind Spot Monitoring. You can drive with confidence, knowing that you and your loved ones are well-protected.

This 2025 Toyota Prius Limited is a true gem, blending exceptional efficiency, premium features, and uncompromising quality. Experience the future of hybrid driving today. Visit our showroom to take this remarkable vehicle for a test drive and discover how it can elevate your daily commute and weekend adventures.
